title: Arkret Principal Locator
description: Signed online locator returned from a holder-controlled Principal Server locator ref. It asserts the invite address used for private invite delivery; it is not a Realm membership grant and not a member_delivery_binding.

subject_id.description: Principal DID of the invite recipient. v1 core defaults principal DIDs to did:webvh; did:web is only valid for principal identity when an explicit deployment profile or resolver policy allows it.

recipient_service_did.description: Principal Server service DID that accepts invite delivery for subject_id.

recipient_service_type.description: v1 only allows Principal Server invite delivery. Omit by default; if present, the value MUST be principal_server.

expires_at.description: Time after which the locator MUST NOT be used to initiate invite delivery.

locator_ref_digest.description: Digest of the private locator ref material. The raw locator token MUST NOT appear in durable Realm events.

delivery_modes.description: Invite-delivery capability hints only; join-time member_delivery_binding is still materialized by Realm policy.

display_hint.description: UI-only display hint. It is not identity authority and MUST NOT be used for authorization.

proofs.description: At minimum contains recipient_service_acceptance. High-assurance deployments SHOULD also require subject_locator_authorization.

proof.description: Detached proof over canonical_json(principal_locator_without_proofs). proof.payload_digest MUST equal that canonical payload digest.

locator_token.description: Opaque base64url locator token with at least 128 bits of entropy. It SHOULD be a server-side handle and MUST NOT plaintext-encode subject_id, recipient_service_did, expiry, policy state, or other invitee-identifying material. It MUST be sent in the JSON body, never in URL path or query string.
